hypotheses.R1_full_rank_reconstructs: The joint full-rank program reaches held-out derivative R-squared at least 0.999 for every active prototype.
hypotheses.R2_both_sides_limit_rank128: For at least six active prototypes, either the context-only or output-only rank-128 approximation remains below R-squared 0.90.
hypotheses.R3_rank512_is_usually_sufficient: At least half of active prototypes reach joint held-out R-squared 0.90 by rank 512.
hypotheses.R4_route_metric_beats_global: At rank 128, the route-conditioned metric has higher median held-out R-squared than the global FineWeb metric.
hypotheses.R5_ridge_choice_is_not_decisive: Median route-conditioned rank-128 R-squared varies by at most 0.10 across the three predeclared ridge fractions.
hypotheses.R6_no_small_equal_rank_program: The median smallest equal Tucker rank reaching held-out R-squared 0.90 is greater than 128.
hypotheses.R7_rank90_program_is_parameter_compressi: When rank 0.90 is reached, the median Tucker parameter count is smaller than the dense restricted tensor.
